manual_review.visual: All required frames show three-vane canoe form; offset quilt/module relief is present; frontal view conveys the central vane and upcurved laterals, top shows trough/seam. Small matrix is visible as a narrow underside support; there is no bead ornament or fully living-organism reconstruction. Based on actual UT/Paleobiology Fig.1/3 pixels and frozen specimen-study scope. 491 reported noncoplanar contacts are between the fossil and its intended matrix support; no blanket zero-intersection gate was applied; coplanar positive-area check has zero hits and reviewed frames show no visible z-fighting.
manual_review.view_review_note: Side hero hides cavity depth as expected; front/top/rear provide cross-view construction evidence.
